headline: Anand Rathi shares fall 6% despite 50% profit growth
hook: Profit jumps but margins shrink at Anand Rathi
summary: Anand Rathi Share and Stock Brokers reported a 50% year-on-year increase in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 41.94 crore. Despite the profit growth, shares dropped 6% as investors reacted to margin compression. Operating expenses rose 14% compared to the previous year, largely due to a 31% surge in employee benefit costs. This indicates that rising overheads are currently outweighing the company's revenue gains.
why_it_matters: Rising operational costs may pressure future earnings for brokerage firms.
